findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, leaving you without leverage or ownership before you receive your money.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract without cause, with immediate effect, and without paying for your completed work or efforts.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing written notice to the other party, and Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed up to the date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a couple of small suggestions to discuss before signing:

- Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers upon delivery rather than full payment, so I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverables.

- Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the agreement allows termination without notice and without further payment, so I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing written notice to the other party, and Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed up to the date of termination.

I look forward to hearing from you.
